caribbean.headline: Martinique Faces Heavy Rain, Light Winds Today
caribbean.paragraph: Martinique is experiencing 100% rain probability, with maximum sustained winds of 10 kt and wave heights up to 2.3 ft. Nassau will see slightly stronger winds, peaking at 13 kt.

mediterranean.headline: Cadiz Faces Light Winds, Moderate Swell, Low Rain Chance
mediterranean.paragraph: Cadiz is experiencing sustained winds up to 16 kt, waves reaching 2.3 ft, a swell period of 11 s from the SSE, and less than 10% rain probability. These conditions are below thresholds for any marine warnings.
